records.quote: The ionogels with 40 wt% EMIM:DCA can have a high mechanical stretchability of up to 156%, low tensile strength of 0.6 MPa, and low Young's modulus of 0.6 MPa.
context_quotes: They also exhibit a high ionic thermovoltage of 34.5 mV K-1, high ionic conductivity of 8.4 mS cm(-1)and low thermal conductivity of 0.23 W m(-1)K(-1)at a relative humidity of 90%.
